$schema.description: URL of this schema — editor completion only

extends.description: Path (relative to this config) of another abap2ui5lint.jsonc/.json whose settings are the base. This file wins per key; the two "rules" blocks merge per rule id. Chains follow; a cycle is refused.

paths.description: Files or directories to check. Used only when the CLI got no positional paths.

ignore.description: Regex patterns; a path reached by a directory walk that one of them matches is not collected at all. Repo-level counterpart of rules[id].exclude, which is per rule. A path named explicitly on the command line is still checked.

ui5.description: The UI5 version the target system runs. Controls and members introduced later are reported; deprecations are reported once in effect at this version.

distribution.description: Which distribution the target system serves. On "openui5", controls from SAPUI5-only libraries are errors; on "sapui5" they are not reported at all. Leave the key out and they are hints - the run cannot tell which system you deploy to.

allow.description: Control or control.member names accepted despite the version floor, e.g. "sap.m.Avatar.displaySize".

anyOf.description: false skips the render gate (no browser needed); true requires it.

pages.description: Size of the render gate’s page pool (default 4). Each page carries its own UI5 boot; a corpus render divides its wall clock by roughly the pool size.

anyOf.description: Require the render gate and size its page pool.

render.description: false skips the render gate (no browser needed); true requires it; { "pages": N } requires it and sizes its page pool (default 4).

cache.description: true stores each file’s result across runs and replays it while nothing relevant changed (file content, linter version, metadata snapshot, resolved settings). Same as --cache; --cache-location names the file (default .abap2ui5lintcache).

failOn.description: Lowest severity that fails the build. Everything is always reported — this only decides the exit code.

maxWarnings.description: More warnings than this fail the run, whatever failOn says (same as --max-warnings). The way to fail on errors only while still capping the warning debt.

baseline.description: Path (relative to this config) of the baseline file: findings frozen at adoption time are suppressed, new findings fail, a stale entry fails too. Create/refresh it with --update-baseline.

anyOf.description: Path (relative to this config) of the shields.io endpoint JSON to write. Writes the verdict badge.

badge.description: Write shields.io endpoint JSON for every run, so the README can show what the corpus IS ("abap2UI5 | 148 apps · 172 views · 2,176 controls") and what the gate said about it ("check-abap2UI5 | 111 rules passed").

rules.description: Per rule: false to switch it off, a severity string, or { severity, exclude }.

file.description: Path (relative to this config) of the endpoint JSON to write.

exclude.description: File regex patterns this rule is not applied to, case insensitive.
